title: Exterior derivative of a test form along an orthonormally parametrised plane, in coordinates
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (∀ i : Fin (d + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ => (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (∑ j, x j • v j) (i.removeNth v)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ => (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (∑ j, x j • v j) (i.removeNth v))) ∧ ∀ z : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ, exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (∑ j, z j • v j) v = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * fderiv ℝ (fun x : Fin (d + 1) → ℝ => (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (∑ j, x j • v j) (i.removeNth v)) z (Pi.single i 1)
